records.subject: Welcome aboard, Granite Collective
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, no project, no invite, no key milestone despite a welcome email [email:b4ece97d] and a held onboarding call [calendar:b5f98708]. No customer replies or tickets at all, so no active signal of intent; accounts silent four days post-call rarely self-start, though 8 days remain.

draft.subject: Getting your first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks again for the onboarding call last week. Picking up where we left off: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that came up after our call.

Best,
Chidi
